Add a screen to get started
Your files stay in your browser · v 1.0Saved automatically on this deviceCreated by: Johnpaul (@Ayo_Design)

Screens to showreel.

  1. Add up to 12 images. Your original dimensions and transparent pixels are kept. Choose a source as the canvas size reference or enter a custom width and height. Screens fit without cropping or stretching. Uploads sort naturally by filename, so Screen 2 comes before Screen 10. Drag the screens to change the order, to set a custom order.
  2. Set your pace. Change time per screen or total duration. Choose Soft or Stiff. Soft eases gently between screens; Stiff uses a quicker dissolve.
  3. Choose a background. Use a solid color, an image preset, or your own uploaded background. Select Transparent for transparent GIF or PNG export. Adjust padding and border radius to frame your work. Video requires a solid or image background.
  4. Choose your format. Export the current preview frame as PNG, a 30 fps video, or a looping, full-resolution GIF with transitions sampled at 20 fps. GIF uses up to 256 colors per frame.

Video renders in real time; keep this tab visible. GIF renders frame by frame and may take longer. Your uploads, settings, and output stay in your browser.
